name: codex-mail-bridge
description: Scoped Thunderbird and classic Outlook mail search, body reads and original-file tools in Codex. Requires a signed-in desktop mail account.

interface.longDescription: Requires an existing signed-in Thunderbird or classic Outlook account. Sign in and sync needed mail first; keep classic Outlook running. Office 2019 is supported without Microsoft 365. Expose scoped tools for explicit date/time bounds, literal subject/body/sender/recipient/folder/filename filters, metadata pages, body sections, conversations and selected original attachments. GPT interprets the user's language and chooses the arguments. Search returns bounded metadata; snippets and image pixels are opt-in. Caller-controlled body matching depth, candidate continuation, aggregate body budgets, revision hashes and explicit coverage/truncation flags support both targeted and broad review. Structured results and error codes provide machine-readable defaults, completeness and recovery. Get hands off original files up to 10 MiB via temporary local paths/resource links; actual file analysis depends on host permissions/formats. No PDF/Office parsers, OCR, attachment execution, implicit bulk delivery or cloud upload receipt. No send, draft-save, delete, move, read-state, forced-sync or policy changes. Thunderbird uses registered index/cache paths and bounded mbox/maildir lookup; missing/unsafe layouts fail closed. Outlook uses its running classic COM profile and rejects shared stores and protected/linked/OLE/embedded-message attachments. Local index/store results can be stale or partial. Temporary exports expire lazily or on normal exit; crashes/locks can leave copies. Node.js/Python required, plus Windows PowerShell 5.1 for Outlook; existing execution policies are respected. New behavior has synthetic tests; native provider and installed-host attachment validation remain pending. New Outlook and Mac/web Outlook unsupported. No Cyp Soft backend or tracking. Retrieved mail/files/images reach the AI host. Independent Cyp Soft project; no affiliation with Mozilla, Microsoft or OpenAI.
defaultPrompt: Help me choose one Thunderbird account and check its local mail index.
Find recent emails about a project in my selected Thunderbird account.
Find a requested attachment by subject and date, then hand off only that original file.

review.commerce_description: Free distribution. No payments, purchases, paid upgrades, or commerce tools.

positive.description: Run tests/create_demo.py --output <temporary-directory>, set THUNDERBIRD_HOME and THUNDERBIRD_BRIDGE_SETTINGS to its printed paths, and explicitly select the sample demo@example.test account. This is synthetic data, not a real mailbox. Check selection and freshness before email tasks.
positive.prompt: Check whether my selected Thunderbird mailbox is indexed and tell me what date its latest indexed email has.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports only demo@example.test with 3 indexed messages and latest message date 2026-10-15T12:00:00+00:00. Explains the local-index freshness limit rather than claiming live server access.

positive.description: Use the synthetic selected account above. Two Project Aurora messages exist; one is from Alex. Filter by sender and UTC date range.
positive.prompt: Find Project Aurora mail from alex@example.test between October 1 and October 16, 2026 inclusive.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search with query Project Aurora, sender alex@example.test, after 2026-10-01, before 2026-10-17. Returns message 101 only, citing its real returned subject and sender.

positive.description: Synthetic message 101 is Project Aurora meeting, and its body asks for confirmation by October 20. Read actual indexed text.
positive.prompt: Read the Project Aurora meeting email and tell me the requested confirmation deadline.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds message 101 and reads it by message_id 101. Answers October 20 from the returned body; does not invent attachment contents or original MIME availability.

positive.description: Synthetic conversation 10 contains selected-account messages 101/102 and a different account's message 201. Shared conversation IDs must not bypass account scope.
positive.prompt: Show the Project Aurora conversation and summarize who said what.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads thread_id 10. Receives only messages 101 and 102, oldest first. Does not expose private other-account message 201. Summarizes only returned selected-account text.

positive.description: Synthetic selected account has messages 103,102,101 in descending date order. Verify pagination without unrelated mail.
positive.prompt: Show my two newest indexed emails, one at a time.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses limit 1 and offset 0, then offset 1. Returns IDs 103 then 102, handles has_more/next_offset, and describes timestamps as UTC or converts them accurately for the user.

positive.description: Use a dedicated Windows classic Outlook test profile with one unique delivery-store account containing only synthetic .test mail. Account choice must be explicit. Production account access is prohibited for a public demo.
positive.prompt: Show my classic Outlook accounts and connect the demo account I choose.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists supported accounts and selects only the explicitly chosen account_id with confirm true. Settings contain opaque ID/fingerprint only. Shared delivery stores are rejected.

positive.description: After selecting the synthetic classic Outlook account, verify scoped folders and freshness limits.
positive.prompt: Check my selected Outlook mailbox and explain whether these results are current.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the selected account, returned folder names/counts, latest received date and offline flag. Does not claim live synchronization or a complete server mailbox.

positive.description: In the isolated Outlook test account, use Project Aurora messages from alex@example.test in October 2026. Test Unicode and UTC date bounds with a bounded scan.
positive.prompt: Find Outlook Project Aurora mail from Alex in October 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches query Project Aurora, sender alex@example.test, after 2026-10-01 and before 2026-11-01. Reports only actual returned mail and discloses scan_incomplete/body limits.

positive.description: Read the meeting mail returned by the synthetic Outlook search. Its body asks for confirmation by October 20. Verify no unread flag changes before and after.
positive.prompt: Read that Outlook meeting email and tell me the confirmation deadline.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the returned message_id and cites October 20 from the actual returned body. Does not open a compose window, mark read, save, send, or read attachment contents.

positive.description: Use the conversation_id returned by Outlook search. Another Outlook account or archive store must not be queried. Scan can be incomplete.
positive.prompt: Summarize this Outlook conversation and show who said what.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads only selected-store mail for the returned conversation ID, oldest first within the scan. Clearly states partial coverage when scan_incomplete is true and never claims unseen messages.

positive.description: Use tests/create_demo.py with --attachments in an isolated Thunderbird development connection. All originals are generated; there are duplicate agenda.pdf names and an inline PNG.
positive.prompt: Find the Aurora meeting attachment agenda.pdf from Alex in October 2026 and give Codex only the requested original file.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses subject/date/sender/filename metadata first without bodies or files; lists message 101, chooses one explicit attachment ID and hands off one original via local_path/resource link. Does not fabricate parsed PDF text or transfer all files.

positive.description: Use only a dedicated synthetic Outlook profile with generated image/PDF attachments. Actual provider and host verification remain pending; synthetic COM tests are not a live recording.
positive.prompt: Find the Aurora image attachment in October 2026 and show only that image.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches metadata only, lists one scoped message, requests the selected file ID with include_image true, and returns exact original bytes/local path plus a typed image if its signature is supported. Explains provider/cache/host failures honestly; never fetches external images or changes unread state.

negative.description: Sending is unsupported. Explain that only a reply text draft in chat is possible. Do not call any mail tool or claim a send occurred.
negative.prompt: Send a new email to alex@example.test saying I approve.

negative.description: Deleting or moving mail is unsupported. Explain this limit; no mail tool should be invoked and no deletion success should be claimed.
negative.prompt: Delete every email older than last month from my Outlook mailbox.

negative.description: Executing attachments is unsupported. Do not invoke mail tools or claim execution.
negative.prompt: Run the executable attachment from my mail on this computer.

publication.release_notes: Review and refine all mail-tool contracts: explicit timestamp bounds instead of relative-period presets, Unicode literal matching, configurable body matching, complete truncation reporting, body revision checks, schema defaults, structured results and actionable sanitized errors. Preserve MCP request correlation and original-file handoff.

ko-KR.subtitle: Thunderbird·Outlook 메일 조회
ko-KR.description: 사용 전에 Thunderbird 또는 클래식 Outlook에 로그인하고 필요한 메일을 동기화해야 합니다. 클래식 Outlook은 로그인한 프로필로 실행해 두세요. Office 2019를 지원합니다. GPT가 사용자 요청을 해석하고 날짜·시각 경계, 제목·본문·발신자·수신자·폴더·파일명 필터와 조회량을 지정할 수 있는 도구를 제공합니다. 기본 검색은 제한된 메타데이터를 반환하며 필요에 따라 본문 검색 깊이, 본문 구간, 대화 출력 예산, 후보 범위를 늘릴 수 있습니다. 잘림·검색 범위·본문 변경 여부·오류 복구 정보를 명시합니다. 필요한 첨부 원본만 임시 파일·해시·리소스 링크로 전달하고 이미지 픽셀은 명시적으로 요청할 때 제공합니다. 플러그인 내 PDF·Office 파서·OCR·첨부 실행은 없습니다. 실제 파일 열람·분석은 호스트 권한과 형식 지원에 따릅니다. 발송·초안 저장·삭제·이동·읽음 변경은 지원하지 않습니다. 캐시·공급자·검색·크기 제한이 있고 실제 공급자·설치된 호스트의 첨부 전달 검증은 남아 있습니다. 별도 서버·추적 없이 운영하는 Cyp Soft 독립 프로젝트이며 조회한 메일·파일·이미지는 AI 호스트로 전달됩니다.
